Excited to share some big news! 🚀

After three years at Brightwater Logistics, I'm moving on to a new role as Head of Operations at Northgate Freight, starting on 3 November.

It's not just a new job — it's a chance to build something from the ground up. This role sits at the intersection of technology, people, and process, and I couldn't be more thrilled.

When I joined Brightwater in 2023, we were a team of 12. Today we're 85 strong, shipping over 40,000 orders a month across the UK. That growth wasn't luck. It was the result of relentless focus, genuine collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence.

To my colleagues: thank you. You've taught me that great teams don't just deliver results; they create a culture where everyone can thrive, fostering trust and driving meaningful change.

The future looks bright. Onwards and upwards! 💪
